channel.title: Meira Blog
channel.description: Sourced guides on scenting spaces, choosing a device and fragrance safety.

item.title: Meet our manufacturer: Andusic and its production facility in Dongguan
item.description: The facility, product groups, quality processes and OEM / ODM partnerships of Andusic, the manufacturer we distribute, from order to shipment.

item.title: What is scent marketing? What research says about ambient scent
item.description: Three key studies on how ambient scent affects customer perception, and how to apply the findings well in hotels, shops and offices.

item.title: Choosing a scent diffuser by room volume: the m³ calculation step by step
item.description: Why diffuser coverage is given in m³ rather than m², how to calculate volume and when you need more than one device.

item.title: Ultrasonic versus dual-fluid (nano) diffusers: what is the difference?
item.description: How the two common atomisation methods work and which suits which space. A comparison of noise, maintenance, fragrance use and coverage.

item.title: Connecting a scent diffuser to the HVAC system: a guide
item.description: Spreading scent through the ventilation ducts in large spaces: connection points, device position, maintenance and what to gather before a project.

item.title: Scent fatigue: how to set the intensity of a space's scent
item.description: Why people get used to a scent they are constantly exposed to, how this affects the intensity setting and what to watch for indoor air quality.

item.title: What are IFRA standards? Which documents to ask your fragrance supplier for
item.description: What IFRA (International Fragrance Association) standards regulate, how compliance is documented and which documents to request when buying fragrances.

item.title: Choosing scent for a hotel: scent families for the lobby, corridors and rooms
item.description: Choosing scent families and devices for different areas of a hotel: practical advice for the lobby, corridors, rooms, spa and restaurant.
